bibliographic-data.invention-title: CAMÉRA POUR DISPOSITIF DE DISPERSION D'AÉROSOL
CAMERA FOR AN AEROSOL DELIVERY DEVICE

abstract.p: An aerosol delivery device includes a housing, an atomizer, a first control component contained within the housing and configured to control operation of the atomizer to atomize an aerosol precursor composition, and a camera system comprising a digital camera positioned on the housing, the digital camera being configured to capture images of an object or scene in a field of view thereof, the images being transferrable locally to a memory configured to store the images, or being transferrable externally to a computing device configured to store the images or display the images on a display device, and a second control component that is distinct from the first control component, and configured to control operation of the digital camera.
